caption: The drawing features two views of a beige or light tan waistcoat: a front view as the prominent central object and a smaller back view positioned to the upper right. The waistcoat in the front view has about ten closely spaced round buttons running vertically down the center, a standing collar, two horizontal slit pockets at either side near the waist, and visible seams. Underneath the waistcoat, indicated by faint outlines, is a shirt with voluminous, billowy sleeves and a high neck that is tied with a knotted cloth or cravat. The back view shows the waistcoat’s rear details, including seam lines and a laced section at the waist, likely for adjustment, along with a similar shirt collar and sleeve suggestion. The drawing is rendered in pencil with light shading and minimal color, and the background is unadorned, in a plain cream or off-white tone. The artist's name, NELTA KOPMAN, is printed in small text at the lower left of the image.
title: Waistcoat
